messages:
alex: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9123 is ready but it's gated on RFC: https://rfcs.redwood.com/rfc/187-serve-routing. Need arch eyes + LGTMs before I can merge. Plan is a small canary tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PST if we're clear. TL;DR: changes routing policy precedence and adds fallback to cheaper model variant. @maya @ken @oliver

maya: Looking now, quick question — do we have perf numbers at ~1k concurrent requests? worried about tail latency impact with the routing change. :thinking:

alex: ran a load test earlier, p95 ~220ms vs 200ms baseline. I added the numbers to the PR description and linked the raw logs. Test command I used:

```
./scripts/load_test --qps 1000 --model=redwood-7b --seq=512
```

ken: heads up, CI integration test failed on the canary config (timeout in canary-run). I'll push a tiny fix to the test harness in a sec.

arch-bot: RFC 187 referenced by alex in PR 9123 (automated link).

oliver: overall this looks fine from a safety perspective, but please add metrics for route-fallback counts and model-switch latency to the PR before merge. once metrics are in i can +1. :+1:

alex: will add the metrics and a short Grafana dashboard snippet. Also adding the rollback plan to the PR: auto-fallback to previous routing policy + disable prefix cache if error rate > 1% in 5m.

maya: please document SLA impact in the RFC/PR — p95 +20ms could matter for low-latency tier customers. can you add a short section? :eyes:

alex: done — updated RFC section 3.2 and PR description with SLA delta and mitigations. pinging for final LGTMs.

ken: pushed the test fix and re-ran CI, e2e passed locally. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Reviewed the metric code, looks good. +1 from me.

maya: quick note — prefer a 30m canary window instead of 2h for initial rollout, unless we need longer to capture traffic patterns. if you update the rollout doc i can give formal sign-off.

alex: updated rollout to 30m with a follow-up 6h staged ramp if no regressions. linking the rollout doc in the PR now.

maya: SGTM — arch signoff pending the rollout doc in PR. leaving final sign-off here once it's in.
